        About this item

        • TRACK HEALTH PATTERNS IN YOUR SLEEP WITH VITALS: Stay aware of the subtle changes in your body with Vitals¹ –it tracks health metrics while you sleep, catches shifts from your usual patterns, and provides tailored guidance based on the insights.²
        • A PERSONALIZED COACH FOR YOUR FITNESS GOALS: Whether you're building endurance for a long trek or training to build muscle, Fitness Index³ delivers tailored guidance based on your fitness level goals. Finally, train smarter with your fitness watch.
        • FREEDOM LOOKS GOOD ON YOU, SO CHOOSE LTE: Make calls, send texts and receive important updates—even when your phone stays behind—all from your wrist. Thanks to built-in LTE connectivity⁴, this smart fitness tracker keeps you connected to what matters.
        • ONE PERSONALIZED SCORE TO KNOW YOUR HEART BETTER: Instead of checking multiple metrics separately, track the single Heart Health Score⁵ based on sleep time, BMI, activity and vascular load to stay aware of your wellness.
        • TRACK YOUR NIGHTS. OWN YOUR DAYS: Galaxy Watch9 gives you personalized recommendations and habit-building guidance with Advanced Sleep Coaching.⁶ Plus, Bedtime Guidance⁷ helps you find your optimal bedtime so you can wake up feeling refreshed.
        • CHECK YOUR BLOOD PRESSURE EASILY: Stay aware of your blood pressure conveniently with your smart watch. Simply calibrate your Galaxy Watch9 using a blood pressure cuff (sold separately) to measure your systolic and diastolic pressure.⁸
        • COMFORTABLE WEAR. FORGET IT’S THERE: A watch meant for daily health tracking should be comfortable enough for daily wear. The unbelievably soft sports band with a breathable air pocket design never gets in the way of your goals.
        • EVERYDAY AI ASSISTANCE, SIMPLIFIED: With the Galaxy Watch9, you can just raise your wrist, start talking naturally and get instant AI assistance⁹—no wake phrase needed. This smart watch won’t slow you down.
        • WATCH PAIRS WITH YOUR ANDROID SMARTPHONE: Galaxy Watch works seamlessly with Samsung phones and also works with other Android phones.¹⁰ Download the Galaxy Wearable and Samsung Health apps to get started using Galaxy Watch with your device.

        • What colors do Galaxy Watch9 come in?

          Galaxy Watch9 is available in different colors based on the size option. 40mm model: Available in Cream and Graphite. 44mm model: Available in Silver and Graphite

        • How much larger is the Galaxy Watch9 battery compared to Galaxy Watch8?

          The 40mm model has a 390 mAh battery, and the 44mm model has a 445 mAh battery. The higher capacity allows Galaxy Watch9 to require less frequent charging. This means you can keep the Watch powered throughout the day with minimal downtime.

        • What kind of processor does Galaxy Watch9 use?

          Galaxy Watch9 uses the Snapdragon Wear Elite Platform. This advanced processor delivers smooth, seamless performance with less lag or load. Also, it supports quick app launches and fluid, responsive interactions.

        • Does Galaxy Watch9 have a clear display?

          Galaxy Watch9 features a sapphire crystal display that delivers a brightness level of up to 3,000 nits, ensuring clear visibility even in bright sunlight. The high-resolution screen provides crisp visuals for notifications, apps and health data.

        • My Galaxy Watch9 is charging slowly, do I have to use the charger that comes with it?

          The Galaxy Watch9 comes with a charger that is specific to its model, and it charges best using only that charger. To get the best charging performance, use provided wireless charger that comes in the box.

        Product Description

        From your first morning stretch to “goodnight,” Galaxy Watch9 makes staying on top of your everyday health easy, especially with its comfortable design that’s perfect for daily wear.

        Stay aware of the subtle changes¹ in your body with Vitals, ² improve your sleep schedule with Sleep Coaching³ and keep close tabs on your heart every day with the Heart Health Score⁵ that also comes with personalized guidance.⁵ Got a fitness goal for yourself? Fitness Index can be your personal coach by recommending programs⁶ tailored to you. And during your daily chores when you need quick AI assistance,⁹ you can just raise your wrist and talk naturally —no wake phrase needed.

        Prioritizing your health gets easier when managing daily tasks is easy. With Watch9 you can easily access your wallet to use Tap to Pay,¹³ control your camera, answer calls⁴ from your wrist and more.

        Watch9 helps you stay connected, stay motivated and get closer to your health and fitness goals.

          I bought this watch for my mom. She's 85 years old and has fallen a couple of times. She doesn't always carry her phone, which would enable her to call for help. This watch is a GREAT idea! I was able to put it on our phone carrier network (Patriot Mobile) very easily. Her phone is connected via Bluetooth to her phone, and it also has its own LTE data. So, if she happens to be away from her phone, she can still call for help. The watch is equipped with a fall detection function. It will automatically connect her to someone who can call 9/11 for her. She can make and answer calls just like a phone. It has so many other fantastic functions. I'm happy to say that it is user-friendly; probably one of the greatest features since Mom is 85. You can adjust the font size for better readability. It's durable and nice-looking. I actually purchased some stretchy nylon fabric bands so she is able to put in and remove it more easily than with the band it comes with. The 40mm is plenty large enough. The 44mm would be huge on her wrist. Definitely a worthwhile purchase!

          Not recommended! I've had to change my opinion of the Galaxy Watch 9 LTE after some time with it. Best to wait for the Watch 10 or 11 LTE for hopefully a much bigger silicon-carbon battery and several other needed changes.

          The latest round is discovering Samsung apparently started selling these watches without the ability to buy spare charging pucks anywhere retail! The existing puck for Galaxy Watch 5/6/7 does NOT work with watch 9. Comes up with a yellow triangle "incompatible charger" symbol. After speaking on the phone with Samsung Customer Service I was able to order ($16 for the puck and $16 for shipping) what is supposed to be one through Samsung Parts (part# GH96-17240A). Having spare car & office pucks for a watch with a battery that only lasts for a day is crucial. I have two spare pucks for my old Galaxy Watch 5 Pro for that reason. UPDATE 10/14/26. The spare puck finally showed up in the mail and DOES work properly with the Watch 9 LTE. The original "backorder" date was 9/11/26, two days after I placed the order, which moved to "estimated backorder" on 11/14/26. So 6 weeks after the order, but I guess I'm lucky I didn't have to wait the 4+ additional weeks. :P

          The alarm volume on the Watch 9 has turned out to be so soft I can barely hear it. I've had to go back to my old Watch 5 Pro for timing the yard sprinklers and such. I can hear that one in the next room.

          The "M/L" watch band is woefully short, as many others have posted now. It should be a "M". Samsung needs to make an "L" available and ideally an "XL". The band can be replaced for some other brand, but it is the principle of the thing. For $450, a large company like Samsung should have a properly sized watch bands available to ship with the watch. The Watch 5 Pro band has the same problem. Nothing screams "excess profit" and "we don't really care" like this recurring multi-year issue, IMHO. :(

          The battery life is a joke, as many people have posted, lasting around 24 hours when many other watches will go for days. The battery life in my old Watch 5 Pro is even less, about 12 hours, so I figured that I would get used to it, but hasn't happened. Especially irritating knowing silicon carbon batteries with much greater capacity are out there.

          One of the reasons I hung on to my old Galaxy 5 Pro for so long is that the glass display is completely surrounded by round metal and therefore chip-proof. Well sure enough this display already has an edge chip on it. :(

          The Watch 9 does have a few good things still. I bought it to get LTE so I could make an emergency phone call if the phone isn't around. That does work via the Spectrum Mobile $11/month watch add-on plan. The Wi-Fi and Bluetooth versions are updated from the Watch 5 Pro and work better. And the biggee: the aluminum Watch 9 is light enough to wear all day long where the titanium Watch 5 Pro wasn't, without becoming annoying. But even then the Watch 9 LTE is 80% the same as the Watch 8 LTE! The case size, display, memory, battery (lol the 9's is 2% larger) and bio-sensors are all the same. Might was well get a cheaper (used, even) Watch 8 LTE to carry over to the watch 10 or 11.

          I'll be looking forward to trading-in this Watch 9 the minute Samsung comes up with a bigger-battery LTE watch that will go a minimum of 2 days on a charge. Also looking for Watch 10 or 11 to have: 5G rather than just LTE; Wi-Fi 7 & 6GHz vs. just Wi-Fi 6; satellite communication which the Snapdragon Wear Elite chip in it already supports; and be round like the Watch 5 Pro, not a squircle.

          C'mon Samsung, time to step up your game here. :( Swallow some corporate chip-foundry pride to be one of the first customers for Intel's new 14A 1.4nm process for a world-class Exynos watch chip! 15% higher performance with 30% less power consumption than 3nm in the Watch 8 (Samsung's own foundry is just now at 2nm with 50% yield). The world isn't all AI parts. :/

        About this Item

        • TRACK HEALTH PATTERNS IN YOUR SLEEP WITH VITALS: Stay aware of the subtle changes in your body with Vitals¹ –it tracks health metrics while you sleep, catches shifts from your usual patterns, and provides tailored guidance based on the insights.²
        • A PERSONALIZED COACH FOR YOUR FITNESS GOALS: Whether you're building endurance for a long trek or training to build muscle, Fitness Index³ delivers tailored guidance based on your fitness level goals. Finally, train smarter with your fitness watch.
        • FREEDOM LOOKS GOOD ON YOU, SO CHOOSE LTE: Make calls, send texts and receive important updates—even when your phone stays behind—all from your wrist. Thanks to built-in LTE connectivity⁴, this smart fitness tracker keeps you connected to what matters.
        • ONE PERSONALIZED SCORE TO KNOW YOUR HEART BETTER: Instead of checking multiple metrics separately, track the single Heart Health Score⁵ based on sleep time, BMI, activity and vascular load to stay aware of your wellness.
        • TRACK YOUR NIGHTS. OWN YOUR DAYS: Galaxy Watch9 gives you personalized recommendations and habit-building guidance with Advanced Sleep Coaching.⁶ Plus, Bedtime Guidance⁷ helps you find your optimal bedtime so you can wake up feeling refreshed.
        • CHECK YOUR BLOOD PRESSURE EASILY: Stay aware of your blood pressure conveniently with your smart watch. Simply calibrate your Galaxy Watch9 using a blood pressure cuff (sold separately) to measure your systolic and diastolic pressure.⁸
        • COMFORTABLE WEAR. FORGET IT’S THERE: A watch meant for daily health tracking should be comfortable enough for daily wear. The unbelievably soft sports band with a breathable air pocket design never gets in the way of your goals.
        • EVERYDAY AI ASSISTANCE, SIMPLIFIED: With the Galaxy Watch9, you can just raise your wrist, start talking naturally and get instant AI assistance⁹—no wake phrase needed. This smart watch won’t slow you down.
        • WATCH PAIRS WITH YOUR ANDROID SMARTPHONE: Galaxy Watch works seamlessly with Samsung phones and also works with other Android phones.¹⁰ Download the Galaxy Wearable and Samsung Health apps to get started using Galaxy Watch with your device.

        Product Description

        From your first morning stretch to “goodnight,” Galaxy Watch9 makes staying on top of your everyday health easy, especially with its comfortable design that’s perfect for daily wear.

        Stay aware of the subtle changes¹ in your body with Vitals, ² improve your sleep schedule with Sleep Coaching³ and keep close tabs on your heart every day with the Heart Health Score⁵ that also comes with personalized guidance.⁵ Got a fitness goal for yourself? Fitness Index can be your personal coach by recommending programs⁶ tailored to you. And during your daily chores when you need quick AI assistance,⁹ you can just raise your wrist and talk naturally —no wake phrase needed.

        Prioritizing your health gets easier when managing daily tasks is easy. With Watch9 you can easily access your wallet to use Tap to Pay,¹³ control your camera, answer calls⁴ from your wrist and more.

        Watch9 helps you stay connected, stay motivated and get closer to your health and fitness goals.
